content_scope: Selected rendered lines for the 1997 Toyota Auto Campaign, its October-December 1997 dealership pamphlet context, the two-card Arcanine/Pikachu claim, and the Arcanine Song Best Collection reuse distinction. This snapshot is not a full campaign archive, not a dealership participation ledger, and not a copy-count authority beyond the selected lines.

selected_lines.text: From October through December 1997, customers who went to Toyota Auto dealerships around Japan could receive a pamphlet with two promo cards in it.
Arcanine (Toyota campaign, Pokemon Song Best Collection CD 1997) (Unnumbered)
The Pikachu was a alternate art reprint of the Pikachu card given away along with an unnumbered Jigglypuff promo in the November 1996 issue of CoroCoro Comic, released on October 15, 1996.
The Arcanine was later printed with the Pokemon Song Best Collection CD. This version is identical to the one given away in the Toyota pamphlet.
